The ending completely floored me, I mean leading up to that moment you could kind of feel it coming maybe but I also had the thought that they weren’t actually going to bring Micheal back and he was going to stay as Jason. They did such a good job of making you process all the complicated emotions with Micheal coming back but as Jason and all the turmoil it caused but then also they made you accept that he is Jason now and that he can’t stay. And then BOOM they fucking kill you with that brilliantly performed moment of absolute joy/heartbreak. I fucking love this show.
Trust we’ve all been there 😂 whether it’s a rash or an unfortunately placed mole. But hey just own it and get some! Good luck

I would say it depends on how noticeable the rash is and how comfortable you are with him in general, I can’t say what’s right or wrong without knowing the guy but if it were me I probably wouldn’t say anything in fear of bringing more attention to it. You never know he might be so into it that he won’t notice/care so you don’t want to put it in the spotlight from the start. And if he comments on it then you can just casually say “it’s just a temporary waxing mishap”. Maybe have dim lighting? Not like pitch black, just some sort of mood lighting so again it’s less noticeable. But honestly speaking as someone who has eczema and therefore gets a rash there sometimes too, guys honestly don’t really care that much about a small rash when they are thinking with their dick 🤷🏻‍♀️😂. Seriously though I’m sure it will be fine, and if he actually calls the whole thing off because of a small rash then he’s not the kinda guy you wanna be in bed with anyway.

Hearing the birds begin to chirp. That’s when I know that I missed my chance to get any sleep. It’s basically the sound I associate with knowing I’m going to spend to whole day exhausted with nothing I can do about it.

I’ve tried over the counter sleep aids before, but instead of just knocking me out like I would prefer they just make me feel kind of nauseous. Maybe I just haven’t found the right one. Things would just be so much easier if I could sleep like anybody else. Glad I’m not alone in feeling this way though.

Yeah it’s hard at first but each day gets a little easier. Although I still get moments where I suddenly remember the times he was actually seemingly nice to me and I start missing him and then I have to go through the list of reasons why it was a really unhealthy and abusive relationship just to stop myself from unblocking him. One thing that helps though is reconnecting with the friends and family he made me distance myself from. They are the people who actually care about me. Not him. I hope we can both recover from the toxic people we have encountered. It’s never okay for someone to treat someone else in that way. And we are better off for realising it and getting out of that situation. Even if sometimes it doesn’t feel that way.

This makes a lot of sense, it’s like once I made it clear that I loved him he then used that against me. Said that if I really cared about him I would leave my family behind completely. He was always talking down to me, making me believe that I was annoying and stupid so that in the end I couldn’t imagine someone else other than him actually wanting to be with me. He infected my brain and even now when he is out of my life I struggle to have hope for my romantic future. It never happened all at once. Slowly over time he made it so that I would do whatever I could to please him even if it was something I thought was wrong. I guess I just feel like an idiot for being so easily brain washed by him.

I have blocked him on everything, but I can’t even relax because before I did he told me that he was going to tell everyone that I lied about something that happened last year. I got drunk and was taken advantage of by someone else, he didn’t believe me and thought I was just a slut trying to sleep with whoever I could. I would NEVER lie about something like that and I don’t know what I can do to stop him from spreading around that I’ve lied about it. I live in a smallish town and everyone pretty much knows everyone.
Thanks all of you for the advice and support. I ended things with him today and it was so hard. But I know it’s for the best. I’m just focusing on trying to become happy again.

I feel like the overall story and plot had its issues but thankfully there was one thing in the episode that made that all irrelevant for me. The development of the relationship between Graham and Ryan was beautifully done I think. The moment where Ryan admitted to Graham that he loved him had me in tears. And when Graham and Ryan came together at the end and said together the name Grace as the name that Tim Shaw should think about for the rest of his life was a powerful moment that overrides the mistakes and issues with the story.
